from.place: Proof, middle projection identity for a closed immersion, justified by exact fully faithful extension by zero and flat resolutions. Pro-etale case with quasi-compact complement.

title: Unbounded closed projection with arbitrary proetale ring sheaves
statement:
Let i:Z→T be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion], and j:U→T its complementary open immersion; assume j is quasi-compact and use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let R be any sheaf of commutative rings on T, and RZ its actual inverse image on Z. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Take iPull and iPush to be the actual derived pullback and direct image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], with identity coefficient comparison. For any normalized ringed-site duality models t on (T,R) and z on (Z,RZ) [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], there is an isomorphism of bifunctors on D(Z)×D(T), natural in both variables:

 iPush(N tensor_z iPull(K)) ≅ iPush(N) tensor_t K.

There is no exceptional adjoint, dualizing object, boundedness, constructibility or Tor-amplitude condition in this statement.

source.place: Middle projection identity, expanded by closed counit and open-closed detection

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-ringed-open-closed] to the actual inverse-image ring. Unfolding identity coefficient transport identifies its sectionwise pushforward with the actual module direct image of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Transfer exactness along this isomorphism. Its invertible counit makes module pushforward fully faithful. The exact left adjoint makes pushforward preserve K-injectives, so [lem-exc-kinjective-derived-fully-faithful] gives full faithfulness after right derivation, hence invertibility of the specified canonical derived counit. For every closed pushforward, [lem-exc-proetale-closed-essential-image] gives zero open restriction. The exact-pushforward and exact-pullback homology comparisons make the derived open restriction zero degree by degree. Apply [lem-exc-open-closed-detection] to each cohomology module for joint detection of zero objects in the unbounded derived category.

Use the specified derived adjunction from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], which is the library mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction and implements [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy]. Choose a normalized tensor-Hom model on the open complement using [lem-sfb-ringed-site-duality-maps]. For each of the three models [def-zl-ringed-site-duality-model], restrict its natural total-tensor comparison from all K-flat complexes to the subclass with flat terms. This constructs, without any choice, the ProEtaleTensorModel required by proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Apply it to both closed and open inverse image, obtaining natural tensor comparisons for the actual unbounded derived functors and the exact specified normalized tensors.

Construct the bifunctorial projection map p:i_*N tensor K → i_*(N tensor i^*K) by transposing the closed tensor comparison followed by epsilon_N tensor identity. Its naturality in both variables follows from naturality of the tensor comparison and counit and both naturalities of the adjunction Hom equivalence. The counit formula for transposition shows i^*(p) followed by an invertible counit equals an isomorphism, so i^*(p) is invertible. The open tensor comparison and j^*i_*=0 show that j^*(p) is a morphism between zero objects: tensoring in its first variable preserves zero since it is a left adjoint in the normalized closed structure. To detect invertibility, complete p to a distinguished triangle. Both exact inverse images preserve that triangle. The cone of an isomorphism is zero by [lem-kun-distinguished-cone-zero], so both restrictions of the cone vanish. Step 1 detects that the cone itself is zero, again giving invertibility of p. Assemble asIso p and invert it to obtain the displayed orientation. All variables remain arbitrary, including empty closed or open subschemes and zero complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersionProEtaleProjection
    {T Z U : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (j : U ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    (hij : Set.range j.base = (Set.range i.base)ᶜ)
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (t : RingedSiteDualityModel.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} (ProEt.topology T) R)
    (z : RingedSiteDualityModel.{u + 1, u, 0, u + 2} (ProEt.topology Z)
      ((proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R)) :
    let RZ := (proEtaleSheafInverseImage i CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R
    let L := proEtaleRingDerivedPullback i R RZ (Iso.refl _)
    let V := proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage i R RZ (Iso.refl _)
    Nonempty (((𝟭 (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules Z RZ))).prod L) ⋙
      z.closed.tensor ⋙ V ≅
      (V.prod (𝟭 (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules T R)))) ⋙ t.closed.tensor)

split_report.summary: The separate middle projection identity is fully proved from the actual ringed open-closed theorem, existing essential-image and detection facts, normalized tensor comparison, and an explicit formal projection map. This node adds no sorry.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes only the middle projection identity of closed-costalk duality.

tool_uses.why: Only existence of the normalized ambient tensor-Hom model on the open complement is used to obtain its tensor and tensor-zero adjunction, not any biduality or geometric unit route.
Generic fully faithful right derivation for an exact-left-adjoint pair, used to identify the counit of the specified derived adjunction.
Only zero open restriction of the actual closed module pushforward, at identity coefficient transport; this is the same elementary closed-support fact of the original proof.
Only joint zero detection for module sheaves, applied separately to each cohomology module. No closed-unit or biduality theorem is used.
